supersedes: PETCT-ROUTE-A-EXPERIMENT-v2.0 (kept frozen; v2 config/schema/code are untouched)
canonical_decision.legacy_policy: v2 config and petct_intent_v2.schema.json stay byte-identical; v3 is additive

grammar.operation_authority: signed cue hard-conditions operation; compiler never predicts operation
grammar.repair_class_retention: conditional on construct-validity gates (expert agreement + visible identifiability + downstream response); failing gates merges REMOVE to two core families

operand_rules.ADD_SAME: learned component pointer over inference-visible components
operand_rules.ADD_NEW: NEW_CUE sentinel; selected-component channel bitwise zero
operand_rules.REMOVE: deterministic cue-hit binding (not a learned contribution)

grammar.rendering: SAME/NEW/LOCAL/COMPLETE are deterministic projections of legal calls, never independent prediction heads

matched_state.group_contract: same patient/study, same PET/CT, same exact signed cue (hash), same operation; only the current mask state varies
matched_state.group_loss_scope: same-operation triplets only; ADD and REMOVE never share a group for loss purposes
matched_state.cue_plausibility_check: every sibling must pass a cue-plausibility gate before group admission

compiler.family_head: operation-conditioned; output space restricted to the legal families of the operation
compiler.pointer: conditional on ADD existing-object families only; multi-positive targets

J1.baseline_reuse: frozen v2 six-class joint head trained on controlled corpus (flat six-call)

J2.baseline_reuse: frozen v2 independent operation/target/scope heads (flat-slot factorization)

training.checkpoint_criterion: max val patient-balanced family macro-F1; tie-break min val_loss

editor.channel_12_contract: central selected-component mask; bitwise zero for NEW_CUE; never a GT-derived map

representation_ladder.J7: flat_action (13ch, gold family call, 10% program dropout)
representation_ladder.J9: typed_program (13ch, legal call with family+operand, predicted or gold)

execution_algebra.ADD: delta = prediction AND NOT current (monotone union)
execution_algebra.REMOVE: delta = prediction AND selected component (hard complement protection)

denominator_domains.rule: 2D-plane and 3D-volume denominators are NEVER mixed; every reported metric carries an explicit denominator_domain field

domains.2d_prompted_plane: metrics restricted to the prompted axial slice; denominators are 2D in-plane voxels
domains.3d_full_volume: metrics over the full 3D volume; denominators are 3D voxels
domains.single_slice_ceiling: 2D operable-voxel ratio (authorized_operable_voxels / authorized_full_voxels); a protocol constant, NOT an oracle Dice ceiling

denominator_domains.official_metric: AUC-Dice and AUC-DMM are 3D full-volume per official autoPET V evaluation
denominator_domains.paired_reporting: editor corrections are reported as _operable / _full / single_slice_ceiling triple, each with its own denominator

statistics.train_randomness: three full-chain seeds reported separately from sampling uncertainty
statistics.multiplicity: Holm within each frozen confirmatory family

gates.G1: fixed-cohort paired 2D/3D curves; legacy gain arithmetic banned
gates.G2: true-group beats no-group and shuffled; natural OOF transfer holds
gates.G4: learned pointer beats nearest by >= 5pp on ambiguous subset or pointer is demoted
gates.G5: predicted chain beats capacity-matched flat-action/continuous controls; gold gain gap reported in absolute terms
gates.G6: confirmation fits complete before headline freeze
